Package index

The plan

Turn an uploaded table into a validated plan. A plan holds planned spend on every row – intent, never actuals – at a configurable grain.

media_plan_from_df()
Build a validated media plan from a data frame
MediaPlan()
A media plan at a configurable grain

Line items and grain

A line item is a channel / partner / tactic combination: the time-free identity a decomp constrains and response models attach to. The grain describes a whole row, which at a weekly grain is a line item for one week.

line_item()
Line item identifier for each row
line_item_grain()
The grain columns that identify a line item, excluding the week
roll_up()
Roll a plan up to a coarser grain

Scenarios

Derive a new plan by changing spend, then collect the results into a set to compare. Deriving never modifies the original, and every scenario records the plan it came from.

build_scenario()
Derive a new scenario plan from a base plan
scenario_set()
Start a scenario set from a base plan
add_scenario()
Add a scenario to a set
compare_scenarios()
Compare the scenarios in a set
ScenarioSet()
A base plan plus named scenarios derived from it

Workflow status

The fixed vocabulary a plan’s status is validated against, so a UI dropdown and the validator cannot disagree.

status_levels()
The allowed plan workflow states

Pairing a plan with a decomp

A plan alone is blind to past and future. Pair it with a decomp – which reports actuals through a date – and questions about history become answerable.

check_coverage()
Check a plan against a decomp (the one pairing operation)

Utilities

short_id()
Abbreviate a synthetic id for printing
print
Print methods for mediaplanr objects
